//: Reviewed config-plugin allowlist — the expo-policy gate locksteps the RESOLVED plugins[] against this file BIDIRECTIONALLY (an unreviewed plugin reds, a stale entry reds), and native-deps asserts every entry carries a reason. A config plugin rewrites the generated native project at prebuild time, so adding one is a native-surface decision: land the plugin and its entry in the same reviewed diff. Write-guard-protected against agents.

plugins.name: expo-router
plugins.reason: file-based navigation — the app/ directory IS the route table the route-manifest gate closes over

plugins.name: expo-secure-store
plugins.reason: hardware-backed credential storage (Keychain/Keystore) — the one-door token store behind src/host + src/auth

plugins.name: expo-localization
plugins.reason: native locale surface: per-app language on iOS, RTL resources — the i18n floor's device half

plugins.name: expo-splash-screen
plugins.reason: native launch frame; its backgroundColor rides the generated dark canvas token (anti-flash lockstep asserted by expo-policy)
